description_zh: 阿曼努拉·汗（1919-1929）是阿富汗国王。他领导阿富汗进行现代化改革，推行教育和妇女权利。建立了阿富汗现代教育体系和法律改革。1919年阿富汗独立后，他推行了一系列现代化改革，包括教育、司法和妇女权利。
description_en: Amanullah Khan (1919-1929) was King of Afghanistan. Led Afghanistan through modernization reforms, education and women rights. Established modern education system and legal reforms. After Afghanistan independence in 1919, he implemented modernization reforms including education, judiciary and women rights.
reason_zh: 阿曼努拉的治理智慧体现在现代化改革和妇女赋权中。通过教育和司法改革实现国家现代化。他的现代化改革推动了阿富汗的进步，但也引发了部落和宗教的抵制。
reason_en: Amanullah's governance wisdom exemplified in modernization reforms and women empowerment. Achieved national modernization through education and judicial reforms. Modernization reforms promoted Afghanistan progress but triggered tribal and religious resistance.
